registered: 2026-10-21, before any fused-baseline score was computed on any scene
purpose: Fair baselines for the fused row of Table III (tab:change): every change row X is fused with the depth residual by the same rule as 'Ours fused with depth residual'.
fuse_rule: usplat.change_baselines.fuse_rank([s_X, s_depth], mask=observed): equal-weight average of mid-ranks, NaN ranked lowest; the code path of eval_change_nor.py for the paper's fused row
metric_rules: as Table III: Gaussian level over the observed Gaussians with NaN last; pixel level by rendering the per-Gaussian scores into every update keyframe (eval_change_nor.pixel_level)
test_runs: once; the reproduction of every Table III cell within the measured run-to-run tolerance is checked first, and a failed check stops the run
statistics: exact two-sided sign test over the 10 test scenes (ties dropped) of 'ours+depth' against each of the 4 fused baselines, at Gaussian AP and pixel AP (8 tests, family F2), Holm-adjusted; also x/10 and the median paired difference
claim_rule: The sentence 'ours fused with depth ranks stale Gaussians best' may stay only if its test mean Gaussian AP is the highest of the 5 fused rows, and it then carries x/10 against each fused row. Otherwise the abstract, introduction and results state the measured comparison instead.
report_all: every fused row is reported per scene and as mean +- std, whatever the outcome
disclosure: an additional evaluation on the NOR test scenes (after Table III and the Table IV ablation passes); stated in the paper
